issues.what: The foreground granules dissolve into soft amber blobs and smeared highlights across the bottom of the frame. The dark channels are blurred along with the bright cells.
issues.fix: Preserve fine granulation in the near field and reduce foreground defocus or texture filtering, especially toward the corners.

issues.what: The cells stretch into diagonal streaks and tightly curled whorls. The smooth, glossy ridges read like marbled molten metal rather than resolved solar granulation.
issues.fix: Reduce directional texture stretching at grazing angles and replace the broad glossy highlights with finer, irregular emissive structure.

issues.where: crop A, surface around the central dark spot
issues.what: The granulation pulls into a conspicuous radial pinch around a nearly featureless black oval, giving the spot the appearance of a cutout with a warped rim.
issues.fix: Break up the radial warp, add low-contrast structure within the dark core, and blend the rim into the surrounding cells with irregular penumbral filaments.

issues.where: crop H, interior of the main plasma arch
issues.what: Evenly spaced dotted tracks and crosswise marks form a visible mesh inside the otherwise fine strands.
issues.fix: Remove the regular streak spacing and improve subpixel sampling; vary strand opacity, spacing, and length so the interior does not read as a grid.

issues.where: crops N and Q–R, solar limb away from the loop
issues.what: A near-continuous bright outline and similarly spaced thin spikes make the limb look like a uniform fringe.
issues.fix: Vary the local density, height, and brightness of the spicules, and blend the base glow into the surface with a less uniform falloff.

issues.where: crops J–L, brighter stars in the sky
issues.what: Some brighter stars render as soft round dots and tiny colored blobs rather than crisp points.
issues.fix: Use a tighter, brightness-dependent star profile and reserve noticeable bloom for the brightest stars.

issues.where: bottom strip of the terrain view, near foreground (crops S-W, y 866-1080), worst at the lower left and lower right corners
issues.what: the near granulation goes soft and smeared, with directional streaks that pull out toward the corners like a stretched or radially warped texture. It does not hold up at native size and looks like a lens-warp or upscale artifact, not depth of field
issues.fix: render the foreground at full resolution with a proper close-up granulation texture; remove the radial stretch, or use a real, consistent depth-of-field falloff

issues.where: sky in the lower left, lower right and left side (crops H, O, T, W, X)
issues.what: the stars are short diagonal dashes and smears, not points, while the stars in the upper sky are sharp points. This mixed motion blur gives away a compositing or generation artifact
issues.fix: replace the starfield with one consistent set of sharp point stars, or apply the same motion blur across the whole frame

issues.where: corona below the lower limb (crops U, V, W)
issues.what: the corona under the disk is a brushy, smudged mass of vertical strokes with a plastic, airbrushed look that ends in a muddy grey haze, unlike the finer streamers at the top
issues.fix: regenerate the lower corona as fine radial streamers that match the upper limb, with a smooth falloff into the sky

issues.where: granulation across the middle ground (crops D, E, N, O, P)
issues.what: the granules read as glossy, wet, plastic blobs with specular highlights, like a molten metal or honeycomb material, not plasma. The cells also repeat in size and shape
issues.fix: reduce the specular sheen, add more variation in cell size, and give the surface an emissive look rather than a reflective one

issues.where: the arching loops over the sunspot (crops A, C, G, K, L)
issues.what: the loops are made of thin, separate spark trails that look like a steel-wool long-exposure photo, with stray strands hanging loose at the ends, not glowing plasma tubes
issues.fix: merge the strands into coherent, softly glowing flux tubes with a continuous emission falloff

issues.where: prominences at the left and right limb (crops D, C, M, O)
issues.what: the red prominence ribbons have hard, painted-looking edges and a saturated red that sits on top of the corona like a separate layer, with a faint halo where they cross the white glow
issues.fix: blend the prominences into the corona with softer, emissive edges and a hue that matches the limb

issues.where: limb at the left and right horizon (crops H, I, N)
issues.what: the spicule fringe along the horizon is uniform and comb-like, with a slightly doubled glow band just above the surface
issues.fix: vary the spicule height and density, and soften the glow into a single falloff

issues.where: solar disk, overall (crops A, F, L, P, Q)
issues.what: the surface detail is a dense, uniform mesh of repeating swirl and loop motifs that looks over-sharpened and texture-tiled rather than physically varied
issues.fix: vary the scale of the surface structure, with quieter regions between active ones, and reduce the sharpening halos

issues.where: photosphere, dark rosettes and the fibrils between them
issues.what: the disk is sharp at native size, but the long curling fibrils and similar rosette centers read as one curl-noise motif rather than irregular convective cells
issues.fix: vary the active-region shapes and mix in irregular bright cells with dark lanes so the surface does not share one swirl
